title: Basecamp Climbing
specs: Over 7,000 square feet of climbing surface and 58 routes
Tallest and most accessible climbing gym in Toronto with walls nearly 40 feet tall
Participants must be 12 years or older for Intro Lesson
Must be 16 years or older for Learn to Lead course
Lead course participants need dynamic rope (40m min), Petzl Grigri, locking carabiner
Top rope certification recommended for Movement 1 class; required for Movement 2 class
Participants must not have any 'Active' Strike(s) on their account for Lead Course
Group Climbs designed for groups of 4 or more beginners
Lead Course groups limited to 3-4 participants

options.name: Movement 1 - Technique Class
options.detail: 1-hour class teaching fundamentals of footwork, hand holds, efficient movement, and route reading; no prerequisites; beginner level (5.4-5.8).

options.name: Movement 2 - Technique Class
options.detail: 1-hour intermediate class focusing on footwork, balance, dynamic movement, and drills; requires top rope certification; intermediate level (5.8-5.10-).

options.name: Overhang - Technique Class
options.detail: Class for intermediate+ climbers (5.9 and up) teaching footwork, posture, and tactics for climbing overhangs effectively.

options.name: Day Pass
options.detail: Access to both Bloor West and Queen West locations on the same day, includes in/out privileges, excludes rental equipment.

options.name: School Groups
options.detail: 2-hour session with rental harness and facility use with staff; participants bring clean indoor running shoes; for kids of all ages.

options.name: Intro Lesson
options.detail: 2-hour Learn to Belay lesson including rental harness and climbing shoes plus day pass; participants must be 12 years or older.

options.name: Group Climb
options.detail: 2-hour session for groups of 4 or more beginners; rentals included; staff to participant ratio 1:5.

options.name: Intro Lesson + 1-Month Membership
options.detail: Intro lesson plus 1-month membership starting the day of the lesson; includes access to Queen West location; day of lesson includes rentals, membership does not.

options.name: Single Month Prepaid Membership
options.detail: 30 consecutive days starting from purchase date; limited to issuer; no guest pass privileges; no freezes allowed; excludes rentals.

options.name: Projector Room Rental
options.detail: Private event space with conference tables, chairs, refrigerator, and optional projector; suitable for birthdays, corporate training, or groups.

options.name: Learn to Lead
options.detail: Advanced lead climbing course for climbers 16 years and older; two 3-hour sessions over two consecutive weeks; groups of 3-4; requires own or purchased gear (dynamic rope, Petzl Grigri, locking carabi)

options.name: 10 Visit Pass
options.detail: 10 individual day pass punch card valid at both Bloor West and Queen West locations; transferable to one other user; excludes rental gear; no expiration.

options.name: 4-Month Prepaid Membership
options.detail: 120 consecutive days starting from purchase date; valid at both locations; monthly auto-renewal; includes 1 guest pass per month; excludes rentals.

options.name: Annual Prepaid Membership
options.detail: Includes 1 new guest pass per calendar month; maximum 21-day freeze per membership year; excludes rentals.

blurb: Basecamp Climbing offers indoor rock climbing with over 7,000 square feet of climbing surface and 58 routes, including slab, flat wall climbs, overhang climbing, and walls nearly 40 feet tall. The gym caters to climbers of all skill levels and provides rental equipment and lessons. They also offer group climbs, school programs, and technique classes.
extraNote: No refunds on unused passes or memberships · Written notice 48 hours prior to billing date required to cancel memberships after initial commitment · $20 deposit required for Lead Test, returned upon passing · Tester availability for Lead and Ohm tests not guaranteed; call ahead recommended
